# Checklist

What to verify before submitting, drawn from the published audit of how these
analyses go wrong [@xu2019quality].

::: {.callout-warning}
Draft. The section structure below is fixed and matches the class; the prose is
being written.

Every `##` section gets its own figure, as in Chapter 1. One H2 is one slide, so
the figure is also that slide's visual, and a section without one leaves the
deck with a blank.
:::

## Before extraction

Protocol registered, dose metric declared, reference handling decided.

## After extraction

Viability check run, doses harmonised, covariance inputs complete.

## Model specification

Functional form justified, knots declared, two-stage versus one-stage defended.

## Reporting the fit

What numbers belong in the paper, and in what units.

## The figure

Exposure range, confidence band, reference point, and what not to extrapolate.

## Common failures

The errors found most often in the published audit, each with the fix.
